rektion: einer Sache (Dat.) beitreten (einem Verein, einer Partei, der EU)
definition_de: Mitglied einer Gruppe oder Organisation werden; Gegenteil: austreten (aus + Dat.)
example_de: Mit 12 Jahren ist sie dem Verein beigetreten.
example_en: She joined the club at the age of 12.
visual_idea: User's scene (joining a sports club at 12) wins: a coach hands a 12-year-old girl her own team jersey while the team in matching jerseys welcomes her with applause. Becoming a member is shown as receiving the shared jersey and being welcomed into the group; Verein = team + club pitch. Typical grammar: Dativ (dem Verein), Perfekt with 'sein', prefix 'bei-' at the end.
image_prompt: on a sunny local football pitch a smiling twelve-year-old girl with a ponytail, wearing a plain white t-shirt and jeans, receives a bright green team jersey from a friendly middle-aged coach, holding it up proudly with both hands; behind her a team of girls her age in identical plain green jerseys and black shorts, completely unbranded fabric stands in a half circle, clapping and cheering to welcome her; small clubhouse and trees in the background, medium wide shot
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: on a sunny football pitch a coach hands a twelve-year-old girl a green team jersey, she holds it up proudly and pulls it on over her t-shirt, then the girls of the team in matching green jerseys step forward clapping and pull her into their half circle; static camera, slow readable motion
